synopsis: The booklet identifies NVIDIA L4 as the data-center GPU used in Google Cloud G2 instances, alongside AWS G6e instances using NVIDIA L40S, as generic GPU cloud execution options [f16202, f8370]. The quoted 2026 public price for g2-standard-32 is about USD 1.734 per hour; the configuration includes one NVIDIA L4 GPU, 32 vCPUs and 128 GiB of memory, and the glossary repeats the price [f9260, f8861, f16064]. Google Cloud G2 is described as pay-per-use, but the table marks its off-road relevance as not applicable, so these facts do not establish off-road-specific suitability [f9259]. A four-month campaign running ten GPUs of the cited AWS or Google types continuously is estimated to cost on the order of USD 54,000; this is a combined planning estimate rather than an L4-only quotation [f8312].
